# Job Tracking Helper

> A job search app. It finds open roles that fit what you asked for, gets each application ready, and keeps track of what you sent. It never presses Submit: you check the form and send it yourself.

Job Tracking Helper is a web app at https://ye.saranatour.dev. Everything past the public pages below needs an account, so please don't crawl it. Booking links under /book/ are private to the people they were sent to.

What it does:

- Searches the public job feeds of companies on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Personio, SmartRecruiters and Workable, plus Remote OK, Hacker News and the German Arbeitsagentur.
- Judges each role against your stated preferences and shortlists the ones that fit.
- Reads a posting's form, matches your saved answers and drafts job-specific ones for you to check.
- Tracks applications on a board or list, with status history, notes and related email.
- Handles mail through your own Cloudflare account, plus a calendar and booking pages.

What it doesn't do:

- Send an application for you.
- Answer demographic questions on purpose, or store job-site passwords.
- Guarantee interviews or job offers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ye.saranatour.dev/): what the app is and how to get started
- [Privacy Policy](https://ye.saranatour.dev/privacy): what data the app handles and who it goes to
- [Terms of Use](https://ye.saranatour.dev/terms): the rules for using the app
